subject: Deprovisioning & geozone erasures - scope and artifacts request
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@starlightfin.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: starlight-compliance@starlightfin.com
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: deprovisioning/erasure proof for upcoming SOC2/ISO audit

Hi Aditya,

Hope you’re well — Starlight Financial has an external SOC 2/ISO audit scheduled for late March and our auditors have requested artifacts that demonstrate Redwood’s deprovisioning and cross-region erasure controls. Specifically they asked for: 

- A short description of the deprovisioning process for customer tenants (who/when/how)
- Chain-of-custody / access revocation evidence (IAM changes) for a sample deprovisioned tenant
- Deletion logs showing persistent-store and KV-cache erasures (timestamps, tenant IDs redacted as needed)
- Confirmation of geo-zone erasure (how data is removed from all regions where replicated)
- Any retention-to-deletion TTL mappings that trigger automatic erasure

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these artifacts, and if so what the timeline is? The auditors prefer certified PDFs and CSV log extracts where possible. If there are any required NDAs or a secure upload method (DocuSign/Portal) let me know.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Grant
Head of Compliance, Starlight Financial
olivia@starlightfin.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@starlightfin.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: deprovisioning/erasure proof for upcoming SOC2/ISO audit

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a combination of: a concise deprovisioning playbook (PDF), exportable deletion-log CSVs with tenant IDs redacted, and a geo-zone replication/erasure diagram. I can also include a sample IAM change history for a deprovision action.

Quick questions to narrow scope so we provide exactly what the auditors need:
- Do they require proof for a particular customer sample, or will a redacted sample tenant suffice?
- Are they expecting real-time logs covering KV-cache erasure (in-memory) or only persistent storage erasure events?
- Any preferred way to share (secure Drive link vs. SFTP vs. vendor portal)?

I don’t expect this to take long — once you confirm scope, I’ll collate artifacts and propose a short timeline (likely same-day for the playbook and 24–48 hours for sanitized logs). If helpful we can set a 30-minute call to walk through everything.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood_deprovisioning_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: deprovisioning/erasure proof for upcoming SOC2/ISO audit

Aditya — quick internal note before you send anything:

- Provide a redacted sample tenant (mask tenant IDs, keep timestamps intact).
- For KV-cache erasure, provide a short statement of behavior (in-memory eviction vs explicit wipe) plus a CSV showing cache-ttl events if we have them. Rishi, can infra pull a 30-day slice?
- Include the geo-zone dataflow map (high-level diagram) and call out our replication windows so auditors understand timing.
- Legal: confirm we don’t need an additional EAA signature for these artifacts. If they request PII in logs, we need a signed DPA addendum; otherwise redaction is fine.

Plan: I’ll review the playbook and the logs once collected. Aim to send external package between 14:00–17:00 PT today. If auditors need a notarized statement, flag here and we’ll escalate to Security.

Thanks — Lauren
Director, Customer Success Ops

Aditya / Lauren — really appreciate the quick response. A redacted tenant plus the CSV slices will be sufficient for the auditors; they don’t require PII in the logs as long as tenant identifiers are masked.

Preferred delivery: secure Drive link with view-only + files watermarked with a short access log. If Redwood can provide a short signed attestation (1 paragraph) that the logs are complete and unaltered, that would expedite acceptance.

If you can send the playbook and the two log extracts via secure link today, I’ll route to the audit team. If you need a signed EAA / access agreement first, tell me and I’ll push it through procurement.

Thanks again — Olivia
